left.title: Bus hits truck on Highway 7
left.text: [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA] A bus collided with a truck near Mile 12 on Highway 7 at dawn; two injured.

right.title: Two hurt as bus, truck collide
right.text: [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA] Two people were injured when a bus and a truck collided near Mile 12, Highway 7, early morning.

right.title: Pedestrian hit at Central Junction
right.text: [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA] A pedestrian was struck at Central Junction on Monday evening; condition unknown.

left.title: Ferry accident reported
left.text: [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA] A ferry capsized; officials say several are missing.

right.title: Capsized ferry: toll rises
right.text: [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA] The death toll from the capsized ferry rose to five, authorities said.

left.title: Car overturns on ring road
left.text: [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA] A car overturned on the ring road on Tuesday; the driver was unhurt.

right.title: Truck overturns on ring road
right.text: [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA] A truck overturned on the ring road on Thursday, blocking traffic for hours.
